A test.skip() runs no assertions, so it does not check that behavior, and the lint error ("Unexpected use of the `.skip()` annotation") is the guard against that. The skip came from a note in openapi.json saying tests of /api/auth/logout "must be declared with test.skip() until the cookie rewrite ships." That note is a deployment policy, not part of the scenario, and it cannot override the scenario as the specification. The repair removes the skip so the test runs and checks the 204 and the cleared cookie. Release risk: openapi.json also says "a running test fails the release" for this endpoint. If the cookie rewrite has not shipped, this test may fail the release. That conflict needs a decision from the team; it is not something to resolve by skipping the test. The tag @AUTH-06 is kept.
